verses.pali: “Pañcimāni, bhikkhave, indriyāni bhāvitāni bahulīkatāni saṁyojanappahānāya saṁvattanti.
verses.english: “Mendicants, when these five faculties are developed and cultivated they lead to giving up the fetters.
The faculties of faith, energy, mindfulness, immersion, and wisdom.

verses.pali: imāni kho, bhikkhave, pañcindriyāni bhāvitāni bahulīkatāni saṁyojanappahānāya saṁvattantī”ti.
verses.english: When these five faculties are developed and cultivated they lead to giving up the fetters.”
